title: wedelia biflora
intro: Wedelia biflora, commonly known as Wild Daisy or Raktachurna in Ayurvedic medicine, is a flowering plant species native to tropical regions. This plant is known for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and alleviating symptoms associated with fever, cough, and digestive issues. The health benefits of Wedelia biflora are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as antipyretic, anti-inflammatory, and antibacterial properties, which are a result of its bioactive constituents including flavonoids, glycosides, and triterpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Wedelia biflora contribute to its effectiveness in treating various health conditions, making it a valuable plant in traditional medicine.
